_scope_note: Reproduces the 10xs-ai-website monorepo's own path values as they were at extraction (2026-08-19), so the mapping from the old hardcoded behaviour to this package's config is readable rather than asserted. Not a default — a repo with no 10xs-kernel.json at all gets verify/config.mjs's generic defaults instead, and that is a supported, working state. The `gates` entry below is illustrative only: the monorepo's real gate suite (tsc, eslint, jest, lambda, check-files, build, ssr-content) is NOT reproducible through this package's four generic parsers alone — check-files, lambda, build and ssr-content stay monorepo-only (see docs/scope in the README). Applying this profile to a repo that is not the 10xs monorepo will not make sense; copy the keys you need instead of the whole file.
